content: प्रसारणम् .²1 Spreading abroad, extending, increase, diffusing, expanding. .²2 Stretching out; as in बाहुप्रसारणम्. .²3 Surrounding an enemy. .²4 Spreading over the country for fuel and grass. .²5 The change of a semivowel (य् र् and व्) into a vowel; see संप्रसारण. .²6 Displaying, unfolding.
